---

## Ingredients

- 2 tbsp butter
- 1 onion, chopped
- 3 garlic cloves, minced
- 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes
- 2 tbsp tomato paste
- 2 cans (28 oz) whole peeled tomatoes
- 1 cup vegetable or chicken broth
- 1 tsp sugar
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1/2 cup packed basil leaves
- Kosher salt and black pepper

## Steps

1. Melt butter in a pot. Cook onion until soft, 8 minutes. Add garlic, flakes, and tomato paste.
2. Add tomatoes, broth, and sugar. Simmer 20 minutes, breaking up the tomatoes.
3. Blend until smooth. Stir in cream and chopped basil. Season and reheat gently. Do not boil.
